mode.description: Release topology: hub, cluster (one workload cluster) or combined (single cluster).

approvals.description: Protected installation approval settings (ADR-249). stepUp names the IdP acr values accepted as approval step-up and their maximum authentication age; without it no approval can be decided. requireRecordingApproval makes metadata packet/syscall recordings need the same individual approval as sensitive acquisitions (REQ-SYS-002).

permissionDelegations.description: Trusted initial permission guard envelopes and matching browser previewers; empty grants no delegated authority.

namespace.description: Connector namespace the installer creates; never kube-*.

bootstrapID.description: Exact already-issued fleet bootstrap ID; only with bundledHub.

bootstrapSecret.description: Existing operator Secret with bootstrap.json, the record read from the bootstrap channel. Never a chart value.

evidenceSecret.description: ADR-196: existing operator Secret with evidence-storage.json and separately scoped history-storage.json, the write-only regional evidence credential; required exactly when the offer names the regional executor. Never a chart value.

alertmanager.description: ADR-231: optional in-cluster Alertmanager base URL that alert DebugPolicies on this cluster read (v2 API, no credentials). Regional executor only.

identityMappings.description: ADR-245: connector-local identity mapping records referenced by kubernetesExec/kubernetesAccessReview PermissionSources (identityMappingRef). Regional executor only.

profileEndpoints.description: ADR-285: administrator Go profile endpoint templates (kind template: addressModes and a port range that maintainers bind to a declared Pod port) and profiles (kind profile: one addressMode and port). Fixed go-pprof/v1 paths; no URL, path or header values. Optional credential specifies only public exact workload audiences. Regional executor only.

credential.description: ADR-302: public exact workload audiences; private values belong only in profile-authorization.json in the existing evidenceSecret.

tls.description: ADR-299: explicit public certificate roots, never credentials. The installer checks canonical certificate syntax and the 8 KiB byte cap. Connector-first rollout; TLS-capable collectors required.

collector.description: ADR-246: the asservat node collector DaemonSet (off by default; disposable-host guard).

namespace.description: The collector namespace, the only one with the privileged Pod Security exception; never kube-*, default, the release or connector namespace.

live.description: Optional existing node live-processing ceilings. Null disables live projections; hub delivery.liveRead independently authorizes viewers.

processingOperators.description: Explicit opt-in to an initially empty dedicated privacy processing group; never ordinary-users authority.

installerEvidenceStore.description: Bundled storage derives these public coordinates and roots. External storage requires all four fields.

clusterID.description: Omit or leave empty for the installer-derived hub cluster ID; a supplied value must equal the actual ID.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: Label keys are at most 253 characters.
